tasks.title: Exact format 3 sentences 20 words
tasks.prompt:
Write a product description for a solar lamp. Constraints:
- Exactly 3 sentences
- Exactly 20 words total
- The first word must be "Bright"
- Do not use the words: amazing, best, incredible, perfect
- End with a period
tasks.reference: Bright solar lamp provides light at night. It charges during the day using sunlight. Easy to install and use.

tasks.title: Two sentences 15 words
tasks.prompt:
Write a short announcement about a workshop. Constraints:
- Exactly 2 sentences
- Exactly 15 words total
- Must start with "Join us"
- Must end with an exclamation mark
- Do not use the word "free"
tasks.reference: Join us for the workshop tomorrow. Learn new skills and have fun!

tasks.title: Four sentences 30 words
tasks.prompt:
Write a paragraph about recycling. Constraints:
- Exactly 4 sentences
- Exactly 30 words total
- The first word must be "Recycling"
- Must end with a period
- Do not use the words: waste, trash
tasks.reference: Recycling helps the environment. It reduces pollution. Everyone should participate. Let's start today.

tasks.title: Three sentences 25 words with phrase
tasks.prompt:
Describe a weekend trip. Constraints:
- Exactly 3 sentences
- Exactly 25 words total
- Must start with "Last weekend"
- Must contain the phrase "lake side"
- Must end with a period
- Do not use the word "boring"
tasks.reference: Last weekend we went to the lake side. We stayed in a cabin and fished. The weather was perfect.

tasks.title: Five sentences 40 words
tasks.prompt:
Write a short story opening. Constraints:
- Exactly 5 sentences
- Exactly 40 words total
- The first word must be "Once"
- Must end with a period
- Do not use the words: king, queen, castle, dragon
tasks.reference: Once a traveler entered a dark forest. He heard strange sounds. Suddenly a light appeared. He followed it bravely. He found a hidden treasure.

tasks.title: Two sentences 20 words question
tasks.prompt:
Write a response to a friend's question. Constraints:
- Exactly 2 sentences
- Exactly 20 words total
- Must start with "I think"
- Must end with a question mark
- Do not use the word "yes"
tasks.reference: I think we should go to the park tomorrow. What do you want to do?
